beats.text: A neural network taught itself what a cat looks like.
beats.note: It was trained on 10 million images from the internet, with no labels to tell it what was in them.
It ran on 1,000 machines with 16,000 cores for three days.

beats.text: The paper led with faces, not cats.
beats.note: The network learned a face detector without labelled images. Cat faces and human bodies came next.

beats.context: The relative improvement the same paper reported over the previous best result on ImageNet object recognition.

beats.text: The internet's favourite animal became the headline for a leap in deep learning.

beats.line: Nobody told it what a cat was.
